links.outcome: Differences in LLM-scored message quality across synthetic patient history attributes
links.effect: Patient sex and religious preference had a statistically significant impact on scores for empathy, encouragement, accuracy, clarity, professionalism and respect. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: A patient's sex and religious preference were found to have a statistically significant impact on scores.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM (GPT-4o-mini) as an automated scorer of generated patient messages to detect bias

screen.reason: Empirical study testing for algorithmic bias (equity/safety audit) in LLM-generated patient communications using synthetic patient data, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
